summary.goal: Implement the pipeline orchestrator that wires all stages together into the complete mull flow: load → extract → synthesize → merge → toc. This is src/index.ts — the public API surface. It handles: stage composition, incremental processing (cursor-based), idempotency guarantees, dry-run mode (extract without writing), result aggregation across multiple sessions (--all mode), error handling and partial failure recovery. The mull(sessionId, opts) function and createAdapter(type, config) factory are exported here.

acceptance_criteria.description: mull(sessionId, opts) executes the full pipeline: load session → build PreExtract → synthesize nuggets → merge into topic files → rebuild TOC
mull(sessionId, opts) returns MergeResult with topicsUpdated, topicsCreated, nuggetsWritten
opts includes: adapter (or adapters[]), memoryDir, llm config, dryRun flag, force flag
When dryRun is true, runs extraction and synthesis but skips merge and TOC rebuild, returns would-be MergeResult
When force is true, ignores cursor and re-processes entire session
After successful processing, updates cursor via adapter.setCursor()
mullAll(opts) lists sessions from all adapters, filters to unprocessed (no cursor or cursor < latest event), processes each
mullAll returns aggregate MergeResult summing all individual results
Idempotency: processing same session twice with same data produces identical topic file content
Partial failure: if LLM call fails, deterministic nuggets (trail decisions) are still written
createAdapter(type, config) exported for programmatic use
Config loading: resolveConfig(opts?) merges mull.config.json + package.json mull key + opts, with opts taking precedence
SessionRef routing: mull() accepts a SessionRef (plan_id, run_id, or channel discriminant) and routes to the correct adapter(s) based on the discriminant type
Partial failure handling: if LLM synthesis fails, pre-structured nuggets from trail decisions are still written to topic files (deterministic fallback path completes)

Idempotency guarantee for multi-adapter: same adapter set + same cursor state + same source data = identical output. Source data changes between runs produce different (but correct) output — this is expected and documented.

observations: This is the composition layer — it doesn't implement any extraction or synthesis logic itself
The pipeline steps have clear data flow: SessionData → PreExtract → Nugget[] → MergeResult
Config resolution order: CLI flags > opts parameter > mull.config.json > package.json mull key > defaults
Zero-config: no config file and no opts → look for .trajectories/, use Haiku, write to ./memory/
mullAll is a batch orchestrator: list sessions, filter by cursor, process each, aggregate results
Partial failure recovery: if synthesis fails, extraction results are not lost — trail decisions can still be written
The idempotency guarantee comes from slug-based merge in the topic file system — this layer just ensures cursors track correctly

steps.title: Implement mull() pipeline function
steps.description: Build the main mull(sessionRef, opts) function that executes the full pipeline for a single session: 1) resolve config, 2) load session data from adapters (via SessionRef routing), 3) build PreExtract, 4) synthesize nuggets (with partial failure fallback), 5) merge into topic files (unless dryRun), 6) rebuild TOC (unless dryRun), 7) update cursor. Accepts SessionRef (plan_id, run_id, or channel discriminant) and routes to correct adapter(s). Returns MergeResult.

steps.specification: Location: src/index.ts. Export mull(sessionRef: string | SessionRef, opts?: MullOpts): Promise<MullResult>. MullOpts: { adapters?: SessionAdapter[], memoryDir?: string, llm?: LlmConfig, dryRun?: boolean, force?: boolean, mullDir?: string }. MullResult extends MergeResult with { sessionId, dryRun, llmUsed, llmFailed }.

steps.title: Implement SessionRef routing logic
steps.description: Build the SessionRef routing that maps discriminated session references to the correct adapter(s). SessionRef is a discriminated union: { type: 'plan_id', id } routes to trajectory adapter, { type: 'run_id', id } routes to forge/relay adapter, { type: 'channel', id } routes to relay adapter. String session IDs default to plan_id type. Routing selects the appropriate adapter(s) from the configured set.

acceptance_criteria.description: plan_id SessionRef routes to trajectory adapter
run_id SessionRef routes to forge/relay adapter
channel SessionRef routes to relay adapter
String session IDs default to plan_id type
Throws descriptive error if no matching adapter found in configured set

steps.specification: Location: src/routing.ts. Export resolveAdapters(sessionRef: string | SessionRef, adapters: SessionAdapter[]): SessionAdapter[]. SessionRef: { type: 'plan_id' | 'run_id' | 'channel', id: string }. Each adapter has a 'type' property used for matching. Return filtered adapter array. Throw if empty result.

steps.title: Implement partial failure handling
steps.description: Build the partial failure handling that ensures trail decision nuggets are always written even when LLM synthesis fails. In the mull() pipeline: if synthesizeNuggets throws (LLM error), catch the error, log it, and fall back to only the pre-structured nuggets (trail decision shortcut). These nuggets are still merged into topic files and the TOC is still rebuilt. The MullResult includes llmFailed flag. Document idempotency guarantee: same adapters + same cursors + same source data = identical output.

acceptance_criteria.description: LLM synthesis failure caught, logged, and does not abort pipeline
Pre-structured trail decision nuggets still written to topic files on LLM failure
TOC still rebuilt even when LLM fails
MullResult includes llmFailed boolean flag
Idempotency: same adapter set + same cursor state + same source data = identical output
Cursor still updated after partial success (trail nuggets written)

steps.specification: In src/index.ts mull() function: wrap synthesizeNuggets call in try/catch. On catch: log error, set llmFailed=true, use only convertPreStructuredFacts(preExtract.facts) for nuggets. Continue with merge and TOC. Idempotency documented in JSDoc: deterministic extraction + slug-based merge = identical output for identical inputs.
